name: Semaphore
flavor: Home and distant arms on a post. Danger with the arm level, clear with it raised. Place on track.

name: Water Tower
flavor: Fills steam engines with water from the town store under its spout. Nearby stations draw on it too. Combine with a coaling stage for a complete service stop.

name: Coaling Stage
flavor: Fills steam engines with coal from the town store under its chute. Nearby stations draw on it too. Place a water tower nearby for complete steam service.

name: Fuel Pump
flavor: Fills diesel engines from the town store through the hose over the track. Nearby stations draw on it too.

name: Power Line
flavor: Carries power along the rails. Chain poles within reach of each other and of a Power Plant.

name: House
flavor: Homes for 20 residents. Each age opens one more level, for 60, 140, 300, 520 and 800 residents; while it is upgraded nobody moves in. Population stops at available housing; food comes from Windmills.
